exposure: giant encephalocele associated with Chiari malformation type III
cohort: Seven newborns diagnosed with giant occipital encephalocele and Chiari malformation type III, delivered at the study institution between 2010 and 2023.
finding: Six out of seven newborns with giant occipital encephalocele and Chiari malformation type III who underwent early surgical resection within 48 hours survived and met developmental milestones by 24 months, although mild delays in walking, speech, and unsteady gait were noted.
